problem.independent_lab_finding: v7 Step 2.6 Action-B loader invokes bare python before the decoded v4 Step 2.6 payload can establish the exact post-OAuth trusted-Python binding. A PATH-precedent fake interpreter can therefore execute before the fail-closed binding proof.
problem.security_effect: This reverses the v4/v5 trust-bootstrap order specifically at the new post-OAuth clean-shell epoch.

remediation_scope.principle: Establish the exact post-OAuth Python binding using shell builtins/system test resolution before any Step-2.6 envelope loader Python executes; then invoke the already-trusted interpreter by absolute path.

exact_v8_overrides.post_oauth_step2_6_preloader_python_bind:
test -x '/usr/local/python/current/bin/python' || { command printf '%s
' 'PHASE_C_POST_OAUTH_TRUSTED_PYTHON_BINARY_MISSING_STOP_DELETE_CODESPACE' >&2; exit 93; }; test "$(command -v python)" = '/usr/local/python/current/bin/python' || { command printf '%s
' 'PHASE_C_POST_OAUTH_TRUSTED_PYTHON_RESOLUTION_MISMATCH_STOP_DELETE_CODESPACE' >&2; exit 93; }; command printf '%s
' 'PHASE_C_POST_OAUTH_PRELOADER_TRUSTED_PYTHON_BINDING_PASS'
exact_v8_overrides.preloader_gate_order: Immediately after exact v4 Step 2.5 clean-shell reentry and before Step 2.6 Action A or Action B.
exact_v8_overrides.loader_template_v8_exact:
PHASE_C_TRANSPORT_PATH='__PATH__'; test ! -e "$PHASE_C_TRANSPORT_PATH" && test ! -L "$PHASE_C_TRANSPORT_PATH" || { command printf '%s
' 'PHASE_C_TRANSPORT_FILE_TRUST_FAILED_STOP_DELETE_CODESPACE' >&2; exit 88; }; fs="$(command stat -f -c '%T' /dev/shm)"; { test "$fs" = 'tmpfs' || test "$fs" = 'ramfs'; } || { command printf '%s
' 'PHASE_C_TRANSPORT_FILE_TRUST_FAILED_STOP_DELETE_CODESPACE' >&2; exit 88; }; /usr/local/python/current/bin/python -B -c 'import base64,hashlib,os,sys; p,s,h=sys.argv[1:]; b=base64.b64decode(s,validate=True); assert hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==h; fd=os.open(p,os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL|os.O_NOFOLLOW,0o600); f=os.fdopen(fd,"wb"); f.write(b); f.close(); assert hashlib.sha256(open(p,"rb").read()).hexdigest()==h' "$PHASE_C_TRANSPORT_PATH" "$PHASE_C_TRANSPORT_B64" '__DECODED_SHA256__' >/dev/null 2>&1 || { command printf '%s
' 'PHASE_C_TRANSPORT_INTEGRITY_FAILED_STOP_DELETE_CODESPACE' >&2; exit 88; }; test -f "$PHASE_C_TRANSPORT_PATH" && test ! -L "$PHASE_C_TRANSPORT_PATH" && test "$(command stat -c '%a' "$PHASE_C_TRANSPORT_PATH")" = '600' && test "$(command stat -c '%u' "$PHASE_C_TRANSPORT_PATH")" = "$(command id -u)" || { command printf '%s
' 'PHASE_C_TRANSPORT_FILE_TRUST_FAILED_STOP_DELETE_CODESPACE' >&2; exit 88; }; . "$PHASE_C_TRANSPORT_PATH"; PHASE_C_TRANSPORT_RC=$?; command rm -f -- "$PHASE_C_TRANSPORT_PATH"; unset PHASE_C_TRANSPORT_PATH PHASE_C_TRANSPORT_B64; test "$PHASE_C_TRANSPORT_RC" -eq 0 || exit "$PHASE_C_TRANSPORT_RC"; unset PHASE_C_TRANSPORT_RC
exact_v8_overrides.loader_change_from_v7: Replace only the executable token `python` in the v7 loader template with absolute `/usr/local/python/current/bin/python`; all decode/hash/O_EXCL/O_NOFOLLOW/mode/file-trust/source/cleanup semantics remain byte-for-byte otherwise unchanged.
exact_v8_overrides.loader_application: Use this v8 absolute-Python loader template for Step 1, Step 2.6, Step 3 and Step 4. Existing prerequisite binding remains v5 Step 0.5 for Step 1 and the new v8 post-OAuth preloader gate plus decoded v4 Step 2.6 revalidation for Step 2.6/3/4.
step2_6_control_order: v8 pure-shell post-OAuth preloader Python binding gate PASS
v7 Step 2.6 Action A inert base64 receipt
v8 Step 2.6 Action B loader using absolute trusted Python
source exact v4 Step 2.6 decoded bytes, which independently repeat trusted-Python/tmpfs/swap/canonical revalidation
